verdict.rationale: Ente states that Auth has apps for mobile, desktop and web with end-to-end encrypted sync across devices. Desktop-specific behaviour is documented: QR-image import on desktop, right-click to edit or delete codes, and official Flathub distribution. A community user also reports relying on it after Authy dropped its desktop app. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported desktop OSes (e.g. Windows/macOS installers), and in-depth hands-on corroboration of desktop feature parity with mobile.
